summary: Describes a mechanism for a restarting IS-IS router to tell its neighbors that it is restarting, so they can re-establish adjacencies without cycling through the down state while database synchronization starts correctly. It also describes how the router can tell when it has synchronized its link state database. It was replaced by RFC 8706.

eli5.summary: When a worker steps out and returns, the team should not assume they left for good. This lets a router say back in a minute, so neighbors keep routing traffic. It has been replaced by RFC 8706.

questions: how routers restart without dropping traffic
